subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus source-level positive/negative retry coverage as sufficient proof for this non-inducible xAI/Grok stale encrypted_content rotation error?
rationale: External PRs normally need after-fix real behavior proof, but the contributor plausibly explains that the exact code-less xAI error requires an organic provider-side model/key rotation and cannot be forced from a client without exercising a different error path.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: Mark proof as overridden and allow normal merge review to proceed on the narrow predicate/test change, while noting that an organic after-fix capture would still be useful later.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future provider-side rotation produces redacted logs showing the retry succeeds in a real gateway run.

options.title: Request a replacement proof plan
options.body: Ask for a maintainer-owned live validation plan that proves the retry helper with a real xAI Responses request without requiring the exact upstream rotation event.

recommendation.title: Accept proof override
recommendation.body: Mark proof as overridden and allow normal merge review to proceed on the narrow predicate/test change, while noting that an organic after-fix capture would still be useful later.
